var backup=EditorSceneManager.OpenScene(backupPath,OpenSceneMode.Additive); if(preservePlayer) ReplaceRoot(backup,scene,"Player"); if(preserveVoice) CopyNamedRoot(backup,scene,"NarratorVoice_Chaos"); if(preserveCave) CopyCave(backup,scene); EditorSceneManager.CloseScene(backup,true); var old=scene.GetRootGameObjects().FirstOrDefault(g=>g.name=="NatureGrassOptimization_Keep25Percent"); if(old!=null) UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(old); var renderers=Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll<Renderer>().Where(r=>r!=null && r.gameObject.scene==scene && InGrassHierarchy(r.transform)).OrderBy(r=>PathOf(r.transform),StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(r=>r.GetType().FullName,StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList(); int enabled=0; for(int i=0;i<renderers.Count;i++){ bool keep=(i%4)==0; renderers[i].enabled=keep; if(keep) enabled++; } var marker=new GameObject("NatureGrassOptimization_Keep25Percent"); SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(marker,scene); EditorSceneManager.MarkSceneDirty(scene); EditorSceneManager.SaveScene(scene); return scene.name+": grass renderers="+renderers.Count+", enabled="+enabled+", disabled="+(renderers.Count-enabled); } static void ReplaceRoot(Scene src,Scene dst,string name){ var old=dst.GetRootGameObjects().FirstOrDefault(g=>g.name==name); if(old!=null) UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(old); CopyNamedRoot(src,dst,name); } static void CopyNamedRoot(Scene src,Scene dst,string name){ var go=src.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(All).FirstOrDefault(g=>g.name==name); if(go==null)return; var clone=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(go); clone.name=go.name; clone.transform.SetParent(null,true); SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(clone,dst); } static void CopyCave(Scene src,Scene dst){ var source=src.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(All).FirstOrDefault(g=>g.name=="CaveTransitionTrigger"); if(source==null)return; var cave=dst.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(All).FirstOrDefault(g=>g.name.ToLowerInvariant()=="cave"); if(cave==null)return; var prior=dst.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(All).FirstOrDefault(g=>g.name=="CaveTransitionTrigger"); if(prior!=null)UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(prior); var clone=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(source); clone.name=source.name; SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(clone,dst); clone.transform.SetParent(cave.transform,false); var behaviour=clone.GetComponents<MonoBehaviour>().FirstOrDefault(b=>b!=null && b.GetType().Name=="CaveWisdomTransitionTrigger"); if(behaviour!=null){ var so=new SerializedObject(behaviour); var next=so.FindProperty("nextSceneName"); if(next!=null)next.stringValue="Tree_Scene"; var player=dst.GetRootGameObjects().SelectMany(All).FirstOrDefault(g=>g.name=="Player"); var xr=so.FindProperty("xrOrigin"); if(xr!=null)xr.objectReferenceValue=player; var cam=player==null?null:player.GetComponentsInChildren<Camera>(true).FirstOrDefault(); var pc=so.FindProperty("playerCamera"); if(pc!=null)pc.objectReferenceValue=cam; so.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo(); } } static IEnumerable<GameObject> All(GameObject root){ yield return root; foreach(Transform c in root.transform) foreach(var g in All(c.gameObject)) yield return g; } static bool InGrassHierarchy(Transform t){ for(var p=t;p!=null;p=p.parent){var n=p.name.ToLowerInvariant(); if(n.Contains("grass")||n.Contains("gras"))return true;} return false;} static string PathOf(Transform t){var a=new List<string>();while(t!=null){a.Add(t.name);t=t.parent;}a.Reverse();return string.Join("/",a);} }
